topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: Hey, you know, life gives us these big, unexpected gifts sometimes, and it feels like the weight of the world just shifts a little. Your grandma's house—it's not just a building now, it's a piece of your history, something to carry forward. I can’t help but smile thinking about the memories you’ll hold onto and the new ones you'll make there. It’s special, really. You both deserve this. Just remember, whatever choices you make about it, there’s no right or wrong. It’s about what feels right for you two. I’m here if you need to talk through anything, okay?
